newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE commodity futures turnover up 2 pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE commodity futures turnover up 2 pct in 96.

text.p: Turnover in commodity contracts on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) rose by two percent to 3.87 million contracts in calendar 1996 over 1995, LIFFE said on Friday.
Total volume in December reached 257,407 contracts, down from 306,315 in November but up from 231,627 in December 1995.
Cocoa futures contract was the volume leader in 1996, with trades rising to 1.68 million from 1.65 million in 1995.
Other gainers include robusta coffee (up 11 percent), wheat (up 15 percent) and cocoa options (up 18 percent).
Among the losers, white sugar and robusta coffee options volume fell by 42 and 23 percent respectively.
Pototoes and BIFFEX futures saw turnover declining by 22 and 19 percent respectively.
LIFFE, which merged with the London Commodity Exchange in September, also deals in sugar and barley contracts.
